#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, subprocess, sys, copy, random

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"
BASE = json.load(open("/workspace/examples/input.json"))

def run(raw_bytes):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, MAIN], input=raw_bytes,
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

def expect_invalid(raw, name):
    rc, out, err = run(raw if isinstance(raw, bytes) else json.dumps(raw).encode())
    ok = rc == 0 and out == b'{"error":"invalid-input"}'
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL(expected invalid):", name, "rc=", rc, "out=", out[:200], "err=", err[:300])
    return ok

def expect_valid(doc, name):
    rc, out, err = run(json.dumps(doc).encode())
    try:
        val = json.loads(out)
    except Exception:
        print("FAIL(expected valid):", name, "rc=", rc, "out=", out[:200], "err=", err[:300])
        return False
    if isinstance(val, dict) and set(val.keys()) == {"error"}:
        print("FAIL(expected valid, got error):", name, err[:300])
        return False
    return True

fails = 0
def T(raw, name):
    global fails
    if not expect_invalid(raw, name):
        fails += 1

def mut(fn, name):
    d = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
    fn(d)
    T(d, name)

# --- root level
mut(lambda d: d.pop("version"), "root missing version")
mut(lambda d: d.update({"extra": 1}), "root extra key")
mut(lambda d: d.update({"version": 2}), "version 2")
mut(lambda d: d.update({"version": "1"}), "version str")
mut(lambda d: d.update({"version": 1.0}), "version float")
mut(lambda d: d.update({"version": True}), "version bool")
T([], "root array")
T("nope", "root string")
T(5, "root number")
T(None, "root null")
T(b"", "empty stdin")
T(b"   ", "whitespace only")
T(b"{", "truncated json")
T(b'{"version":1,}', "trailing comma")
T(json.dumps(BASE).encode()[:-3], "cut tail")
T(json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"x", "trailing garbage")
T(b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + json.dumps(BASE).encode(), "BOM")
T(b'\xff\xfe' + json.dumps(BASE).encode(), "invalid utf8")
T(json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"\n\n  \t\n", "trailing whitespace OK?")  # should be VALID -> handled below

# --- config
CFG_KEYS = list(BASE["config"].keys())
for k in CFG_KEYS:
    mut(lambda d, k=k: d["config"].pop(k), "config missing "+k)
    mut(lambda d, k=k: d["config"].update({k+"_x": 1}), "config extra "+k)
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"slots": 0}), "slots 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"slots": 257}), "slots 257")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"slots": "2"}), "slots str")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"slots": 2.0}), "slots float")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"slots": True}), "slots bool")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"window": 0}), "window 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"window": 17}), "window 17")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"kernel_bump": 1}) , "config unknown key")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"idle_timeout": 0}), "idle 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"idle_timeout": 10**12+1}), "idle big")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"len_quantum": 0}), "lenq 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"len_quantum": 65536}), "lenq 65536")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"gap_quantum": 0}), "gapq 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"rate_num": 0}), "rate_num 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"rate_den": 0}), "rate_den 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"rate_den": 10**6+1}), "rate_den big")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"bucket_capacity": 0}), "bucket 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"bucket_capacity": 513}), "bucket 513")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"initial_tokens": 3}), "initial>bucket")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"initial_tokens": -1}), "initial -1")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"pending_capacity": 0}), "pendcap 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"pending_capacity": 513}), "pendcap 513")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"lanes": 0}), "lanes 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"lanes": 5}), "lanes 5")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [1]}), "service short")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [1,1,1]}), "service long")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [0,1]}), "service 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"service": [10**6+1,1]}), "service big")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"fallback": 2}), "fallback big")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"fallback": -1}), "fallback neg")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": []}), "time_edges empty")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": list(range(17))}), "time_edges 17 & first!=0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": [1]}), "time_edges first != 0")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": [0,0]}), "time_edges not increasing")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": [0,-1]}), "time_edges negative")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"count_edges": [0,20001]}), "count_edges big")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"count_edges": [0,1,1]}), "count_edges dup")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": []}), "prob empty")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[65536],[0]]}), "prob extra row")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[65536,0]]}), "prob wide row")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[65537]]}), "prob 65537")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[-1]]}), "prob -1")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"probability": [[65536],[65536]]}), "prob rows mismatch")
mut(lambda d: d["config"].update({"time_edges": [0,5]}), "prob shape vs edges")

# --- model
MK = list(BASE["model"].keys())
for k in MK:
    mut(lambda d, k=k: d["model"].pop(k), "model missing "+k)
    mut(lambda d, k=k: d["model"].update({k+"z": 0}), "model extra "+k)
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"classes": 1}), "classes 1")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"classes": 9}), "classes 9")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"embedding_dim": 0}), "E 0")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"embedding_dim": 5}), "E 5")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].pop("length_embedding") or d["model"].update({"length_embedding": [[0]]*15}), "len_emb 15 rows")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"length_embedding": [[0,0]]*16}), "len_emb wrong E")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"length_embedding": [[128]]*16}), "len_emb 128")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"length_embedding": [[-129]]*16}), "len_emb -129")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"gap_embedding": [[0]]*15}), "gap_emb 15 rows")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"kernel": 0}), "K 0")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"kernel": 6}), "K 6")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"kernel": 3}), "K > window")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": []}), "F 0")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": [[[[1,0]]]]*9}), "F 9")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": [[[1,0,0]]]}), "conv 2E wrong")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": [[[1,0]],[[1,0]]]}), "conv K wrong")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_weights": [[[[128,0]]]]}), "conv weight 128")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_bias": []}), "conv_bias len")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_bias": [2**31]}), "conv_bias 2^31")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_bias": [-2**31-1]}), "conv_bias neg")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_shift": [17]}), "conv_shift 17")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_shift": [-1]}), "conv_shift -1")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"conv_shift": []}), "conv_shift len")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_weights": [[0]]}), "dense_w rows")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_weights": [[0,0]]}), "dense_w cols")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_weights": [[-129]]}), "dense_w val")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_bias": [0]}), "dense_b len")
mut(lambda d: d["model"].update({"dense_bias": [0, 2**31]}), "dense_b val")

# --- connections
mut(lambda d: d["connections"].pop(), "conn missing key (whole obj)")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].pop("id"), "conn no id")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"x": 1}), "conn extra")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id": ""}), "empty id")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id": "a"*33}), "id 33")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id": "a b"}), "id space")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id": "a.b"}), "id dot")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"id": "\u00e9"}), "id non-ascii")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][1].update({"id": "a"}), "dup id")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"slot": 2}), "slot >= S")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"slot": -1}), "slot neg")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"label": 2}), "label >= C")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"label": -1}), "label neg")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"split": "train"}), "bad split")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"][0].update({"split": 1}), "split int")
mut(lambda d: d.update({"connections": {}}), "connections dict")
mut(lambda d: d["connections"].append({"id": "x%d"%_, "slot":0, "label":0, "split":"dev"}) if False else None, "noop")
# 2049 connections
d = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
d["config"]["slots"] = 256
d["connections"] = [{"id":"c%04d"%i,"slot":i%256,"label":0,"split":"dev"} for i in range(2049)]
T(d, "2049 connections")
d["connections"] = d["connections"][:2048]
if not expect_valid(d, "2048 connections"): fails += 1

# --- packets
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].pop("time"), "pkt no time")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"x":1}), "pkt extra")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time": -1}), "pkt time neg")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time": 10**12+1}), "pkt time big")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"time": "0"}), "pkt time str")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"length": 65536}), "pkt length big")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"length": -1}), "pkt length neg")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"draw": 65536}), "pkt draw big")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"draw": -1}), "pkt draw neg")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"connection": "zzz"}), "unknown connection")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][0].update({"connection": 1}), "connection int")
mut(lambda d: d["packets"][1].update({"time": 0}), "time decrease")
mut(lambda d: d.update({"packets": {}}), "packets dict")
d = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
d["packets"] = [{"time": i, "connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0} for i in range(20001)]
T(d, "20001 packets")
d["packets"] = d["packets"][:20000]
if not expect_valid(d, "20000 packets"): fails += 1

# --- duplicate keys / non-finite via raw text
raw = json.dumps(BASE)
T(raw.replace('"version": 1', '"version": 1, "version": 1', 1), "dup root key raw")
T(raw.replace('"slots": 2', '"slots": 2, "slots": 2', 1), "dup config key raw")
T(raw.replace('"time": 0', '"time": 0, "time": 0', 1), "dup pkt key raw")
T(raw.replace('"id": "a"', '"id": "a", "id": "a"', 1), "dup conn key raw")
T(raw.replace('"length": 0', '"length": NaN', 1), "NaN")
T(raw.replace('"length": 0', '"length": Infinity', 1), "Infinity")
T(raw.replace('"length": 0', '"length": -Infinity', 1), "-Infinity")
T(raw.replace('"length": 0', '"length": 1e5', 1), "float exponent")
T(raw.replace('"length": 0', '"length": 0.0', 1), "float 0.0")
T(b'{"version":1,"config":' + b'[' * 200000 + b']'*200000, "deep nesting")
# oversized input
big = copy.deepcopy(BASE)
big["packets"] = [{"time": 0, "connection":"a","length":0,"draw":0}] * 20000
s = json.dumps(big, indent=4)
pad = s + "\n" * (16*1024*1024 - len(s) + 1)
T(pad.encode(), "input > 16MiB")
if not expect_valid(big, "big valid input"): fails += 1

# valid sanity: leading/trailing whitespace
if not expect_valid(BASE, "base valid"): fails += 1
rc, out, err = run(b"\n\t " + json.dumps(BASE).encode() + b"\n\n")
if out != json.dumps(json.load(open("/workspace/examples/expected.json")), separators=(",",":")).encode():
    print("FAIL: whitespace-wrapped valid input"); fails += 1

print("total failures:", fails)
PYEOF
